lesson.subject: Mathematics
lesson.subtopic: Construction: parallel and perpendicular lines, bisection, and angles 90 and 60 degrees

entry-behaviour.item: Students have been taught how to draw lines.

references.item: New General Mathematics for Junior Secondary school book 1 by MF Macrae Page 172-176

step.title: Step 1 — intersecting lines
step.plan-content: Teacher draws intersecting lines and ask students to measure some angles, while the students measure some angles.

activities.activity: draws intersecting lines and asks students to measure some angles

step.title: Step 2 — parallel lines
step.plan-content: Teacher draws the construction of parallel lines on the board step by step, using a set square and ruler and explaining aloud as she draws, while the students follow and replicate it in their notes.

activities.activity: draws the construction of parallel lines on the board step by step, using a set square and ruler and explaining aloud as she draws
construct parallel lines, following the teacher's board construction and replicating it in their notes

step.title: Step 3 — perpendicular lines
step.plan-content: Teacher draws perpendicular lines on the board step by step, using a set square and ruler and explaining aloud as she draws, while the students follow and replicate it in their notes.

activities.activity: draws perpendicular lines on the board step by step, using a set square and ruler and explaining aloud as she draws
follow the teacher's board construction and replicate it in their notes

step.title: Step 4 — construction of line segments
step.plan-content: Teacher draws the bisection of a line segment on the board step by step with a pair of compasses, explaining aloud as she draws, while the students follow and replicate it in their notes.

activities.activity: draws the bisection of a line segment on the board step by step with a pair of compasses, explaining aloud as she draws
construct line segment, following the teacher's board construction and replicating it in their notes

step.title: Step 5 — angle $90^\circ$
step.plan-content: Teacher constructs angle $90^\circ$ on the board step by step by compass arcs from a point on the line, explaining aloud as she constructs, while the students follow and replicate it in their notes.

activities.activity: constructs angle 90 degrees on the board step by step by compass arcs from a point on the line, explaining aloud as she constructs
construct angle 90 degrees, following the teacher's board construction and replicating it in their notes

step.title: Step 6 — angle $60^\circ$
step.plan-content: Teacher constructs angle $60^\circ$ on the board step by step by compass arcs of equal radius from the endpoint, explaining aloud as she constructs, while the students follow and replicate it in their notes.

activities.activity: constructs angle 60 degrees on the board step by step by compass arcs of equal radius from the endpoint, explaining aloud as she constructs
construct angle 60 degrees, following the teacher's board construction and replicating it in their notes
